# 01 Quickstart

Welcome to the gothic quickstart. This chapter gets a working app on screen.

## Create a project

```sh
go get github.com/metruzanca/gothic
```

A **model** is the entire state of your app. See the [guide](README.md).

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Count` | clicks |

> **Note**: procedures run on the server.
